item.title: Rising Gang Violence in Haiti Amid Allegations Against Police - fundsforNGOs News
item.description: Haiti is facing a severe surge in gang violence, with at least 26 gangs operating in Port-au-Prince and surrounding areas, forcing 1.4 million people to flee and causing thousands of deaths.
